overview.description: Experiment is a dedicated-deck commercial card game where players collect coloured laboratory cards to complete task cards.
overview.deck: Dedicated Experiment laboratory and task cards

history.origins: Designed by Tim De Rycke and Sander Vernyns, Experiment is a laboratory-themed dedicated deck game where players mix colours and complete professor-assigned tasks over twelve rounds.
timeline: Documented card-play form: Experiment is described as a distinct game with its own rules.
history.cultural: Experiment is included because it has a distinct play system rather than being only a title or expansion page.

setup.deck: Dedicated Experiment laboratory and task cards
setup.equipment: Dedicated Experiment laboratory and task cards, score area, and enough table space for play.
setup.dealing: Deal laboratory cards and task options from the dedicated deck; each round begins by determining player influence.

rules.objective: Complete the most valuable tasks by discarding lab cards that match the required flask colours and numbers.
rules.gameplay: Each round determines influence, lets players choose a laboratory or task card, then allows task completion by discarding matching colour cards, including mixed secondary colours.
keyRules: Primary colours can combine into secondary colours.

strategy.basic: Take tasks that fit your colour pipeline; chasing high-value tasks without the right lab cards wastes rounds.
strategy.intermediate: Track the cards, suits, or resources that control the next legal plays, and avoid giving opponents a simple route to their scoring condition.

phases.label: Deal
phases.notes: Dealer distributes 7 cards to each player (2-player game) or 5 cards (3+ players). Remaining cards form the Stock (Ocean).

phases.label: Player Turn
phases.notes: Player asks another player for a specific rank they hold, or draws from stock if they have no cards.

phases.label: Response
phases.notes: Asked player either gives all matching cards or says 'Go Fish'.

phases.label: Complete Book
phases.notes: Any player with 4 cards of the same rank lays them down face-up as a completed book.

phases.label: Check Game End
phases.notes: System checks if all books have been collected or stock is empty.
